# Vendored TimeXer implementation

Source: https://github.com/thuml/TimeXer/tree/76011909357972bd55a27adba2e1be994d81b327

Wang et al., *TimeXer: Empowering Transformers for Time Series Forecasting with Exogenous Variables*, NeurIPS 2024. https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.19072

`UPSTREAM.json` records the original and packaged file digests. Changes are limited to package-relative imports and lazy loading of the unused Reformer attention dependency. The accepted price/exogenous variants retain the official forward architecture. The upstream snapshot has no standalone license file; no substitute license is asserted here.
